svg.title: Black Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Museum-owning company’s 2019 report page 11 identifies newly acquired Black Curve 1994 and shows it at the far left of the gallery photograph, apart from smaller prints. Bowed upper-left contour and two straight edges approximated from the small photo; no surrounding white wall included.
